an10.213:1.1: dasahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye
an10.213:1.13: imehi kho bhikkhave dasahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an10.213:2.1: dasahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo yathābhataṃ evaṃ sagge
an10.213:2.13: imehi kho bhikkhave dasahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo yathābhataṃ evaṃ saggeti.
